sections.mechanism: Fixed phone silhouette/status/lower badges; empty projected rounded hexagonal face; small initial residual stars
Analytic rise of original winding-road artwork inside projected face; separate growing semicircular sun/glow
Text fade; 165 seeded golden stars; two expanding rings; original cursor moves across main badge and drives small three-dimensional pitch/yaw
Camera scales phone 1→1.82→1 along measured x/y route; cursor becomes hand; secondary 43-star burst and rings at 6.22 s
45-star burst/rings, hand travels down and right while stars continue falling; no loop reset
